## Detailed Findings

#### 1. Cline symlinked rule files SMALL ~2-3h (config, rule loader)

- **What**: Cline PR #14912 (merged 2026-10-12) loads symlinked rule files from config directories. Commit title: "fix: load and watch symlinked rule files". Cline rule loader (`.clinerules`, `.vscode/.clinerules`, `.vscode-remote/.clinerules`, `.cline/rules/`) previously skipped symlinks (stat check rejected non-regular files). Users symlinking shared rule files (e.g. monorepo-wide rule -> project `.cline/rules/config.md`) saw rules ignored, no error message. Fix: (1) scanner accepts symlinks via `stats.isFile() || stats.isSymbolicLink()` (broken links still skipped, stat fails), (2) reads rule content through the link path (target already visible to `fs.readFile`), (3) each new session re-reads rules so edits to symlink targets are picked up on next refresh, (4) does NOT watch symlink targets (review feedback: watching wherever links point is larger change than bug needs, carries loose ends for directory links, readlink per file on every refresh). PR originally added target-directory watching + chain walk + broken-link retention, but review feedback stripped that, kept only stat-based symlink acceptance in scanners.

- **Why**: Alexi has rule loading under `.kilo/rules/` (per AGENTS.md / kilo.json config). Check if rule loader supports symlinks or fails. Cline issue: users symlinking shared rule files saw silent ignore (no rules, no error). Alexi equivalent: (1) grep for rule loader in `src/` (likely `src/config/`, `src/utils/`, or rule-related modules under `src/`), (2) check if scanner accepts symlinks (`stats.isFile() || stats.isSymbolicLink()`), (3) check if broken symlinks are skipped gracefully (stat fails, no error bubbles to user), (4) if gap exists, add symlink acceptance to scanner (accept `isSymbolicLink()`, skip broken links, read through link path), (5) test symlinking a rule file from outside `.kilo/rules/` (e.g. `ln -s ../../shared-rules.md .kilo/rules/shared.md`), verify rule loads, verify broken link skipped silently. SMALL ~2-3h: audit rule loader for symlink support, add symlink acceptance if missing, test symlinked rule file + broken link.

- **Source**: https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/14912 (symlinked rule files), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/.kilo/rules/ (Alexi rule directory per AGENTS.md), grep for rule loader in src/ (rule loading module TBD)

- **Category**: config (rule loader, symlink support)

- **Size**: SMALL ~2-3h (audit rule loader for symlink acceptance, add `stats.isSymbolicLink()` check if missing, test symlinked rule file from outside `.kilo/rules/`, verify broken link skipped)

#### 3. Cline scheduled runs bun:sqlite fixes REFERENCE-ONLY (desktop, schedules)

- **What**: Cline PR #14998 (merged 2026-10-12) fixes scheduled runs under bun:sqlite. Commit title: "fix(schedules): stuck pending runs, silent model failures, stale editor models". Four issues: (1) `claimDueRuns` bound unprefixed named parameters, which bun:sqlite binds as NULL, so desktop hub never claimed a queued run (every scheduled run stayed pending forever, no error), (2) provider failures (e.g. retired model id) resolved turn with `finishReason: 'error'` instead of throwing, so runs were recorded as successful with no error message, (3) schedule editor only used bundled provider catalog (stale), offered retired models (e.g. space-bunny) that live list no longer has, (4) backlog of queued cron occurrences (piled up while claiming was broken) would replay every missed slot back-to-back once claiming fixed. Fixes: (1) SQL query parameter binding adjusted for bun:sqlite (prefix named params or use positional params), (2) fail runs whose agent turn ends with `finishReason: 'error'` (record as failed, include error message), (3) load live models in schedule editor (refresh from live catalog, not bundled), (4) skip superseded queued cron occurrences (cancel queued runs when newer queued occurrence of same schedule exists, only latest runs). PR adds tests for `claimDueRuns` under bun:sqlite.

- **Why**: Alexi has no scheduled runs (no desktop app, no background cron scheduler). Alexi runs are CLI-driven (one-shot `alexi chat`, no persistent scheduler). REFERENCE-ONLY: Cline PR shows bun:sqlite parameter binding quirks (unprefixed named params bind as NULL) and scheduled-run state machine patterns (claim due runs, fail on error finish, skip superseded cron occurrences). If Alexi adds scheduled runs (e.g. `alexi schedule create ...` command, persistent background scheduler), remember: (1) bun:sqlite requires prefixed named params or positional params, (2) record `finishReason: 'error'` as failed run (not success), (3) load live model catalog in editor (not bundled stale catalog), (4) cancel superseded queued cron occurrences (prevent backlog replay).

- **Source**: https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/14998 (scheduled runs bun:sqlite fixes), N/A (Alexi has no scheduled runs)

- **Category**: N/A (desktop, schedules, reference-only)

- **Size**: SKIP. Alexi has no scheduled runs. Reference for future background scheduler implementation.

#### 4. Kilocode connection reset backoff SKIP (core, error-backoff)

- **What**: Carry-forward from 2026-10-11 research #1. Kilocode PR #14893 moves connection reset retry to normal backoff path. Alexi audit 2026-10-12: `src/core/error-backoff.ts` L296-308 `isFatal(err)` method includes retry-limit-exhaustion check. Lines 300-305: `if (err !== undefined && isRetryableError(err) && this.consecutiveErrors >= this.config.maxRetries) { return true; }`. When error is retryable (`ECONNRESET`, xAI capacity, rate limit) AND retry budget exhausted (`consecutiveErrors >= maxRetries`), `isFatal()` returns true. Callers (NetworkManager, provider layer) check `isFatal()` and stop retrying. **Feature already implemented correctly**. Tests in `src/core/__tests__/error-backoff.test.ts` L201-266 cover `isFatal(err)` with exhausted budget (transient error at budget exhaustion returns true, non-retryable error returns false, reset clears exhaustion).

- **Why**: Yesterday's research (2026-10-11 #1) proposed auditing `error-backoff.ts` for retry-limit-exhaustion check in `isFatal()`. Audit complete 2026-10-12: Alexi already implements this pattern. `isRetryableError(err)` includes `ECONNRESET` via `isRateLimitError()` and `isXAICapacityError()`. When budget exhausted, `isFatal(err)` returns true, preventing double-retry by outer layer. SKIP - no gap exists.

- **Source**: https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14893 (connection reset backoff), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/core/error-backoff.ts L296-308 (isFatal method with retry-limit-exhaustion check L300-305), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/core/__tests__/error-backoff.test.ts L201-266 (isFatal exhaustion tests)

- **Category**: N/A (core, error-backoff, already implemented)

- **Size**: SKIP. Alexi already implements retry-limit-exhaustion check in `isFatal()`. Verified 2026-10-12.

Alexi audit 2026-10-12: `src/mcp/cleanup.ts` exports `cleanupInterrupted` function (L56-90). Function attempts, in order: `client.close()`, `client.transport?.close()`, `process.kill()`. All failures logged at debug level and swallowed (caller surfaces original error). `src/mcp/client.ts` L1159 calls `cleanupInterrupted(config.name, connection.client, connection.process)` when handshake aborts (comment L1157-1159: "repeated interruptions during `alexi server` runs leak file descriptors, cleanup on abort"). **Feature already implemented correctly**. Interrupt cleanup matches Kilocode pattern: graceful close -> transport close -> process kill, all best-effort.

- **Why**: Yesterday's research (2026-10-11 #2) proposed auditing MCP startup for Ctrl+C cleanup. Audit complete 2026-10-12: Alexi already implements cleanup-on-interrupt via `cleanupInterrupted` helper. Abort signal during connect triggers cleanup before error propagates. SKIP - no gap exists.
